title: City Park sample screen (screen 6, the old oak)
note: Your picks of 26 Oct: the trees Pepper climbs at true width with one leaf mass whose top is above the world (decision 1), and young 6 m mid trees (decision 2b). Screen 6 at both cameras: up on the high road she now runs through the old oak's leaves; down on the path the oak stands at full size with its branches as her ledges. New: the old oak (trunk 1.2 m, 54 px), the park lime (trunk 0.8 m, 36 px, here and on the ash's place at the right edge until the ash is made), three young mid trees (a lime, a maple, a birch, 138 px). Nothing she stands on moved. Checks: PEPPER UNCHANGED, flow 125/125, Tiled, physics 97/97, QA 0 problems, curve T1-T4 PASS. Layers stay light to dark: sky 202, far city 191, tree line 181, mid 159, back 134-138, play 80-87. SpriteCook 132 credits.
question: The model drew the trees bigger than the spec: lime trunk 36 px (spec 23) and crown 10 m, oak trunk 54 px (spec 46). Both are inside the plan's true sizes for park trees (trunks 0.4-0.8 m, an oak 1-1.3 m), so I kept them. Keep, or ask for slimmer limes? Screens 5 and 7 still mix the new trees with the old small crowns until the rest of the family is made.
